title: 第1章 圣兽战魂第2章 永恒炼狱凤凰
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
传说，每当天道沦丧，轮回走到尽头的时候，无尽界域中就会诞生十头‘太古混沌巨兽’。
它们有着堪比神域般巨大的身体，它们所到之处，天崩地裂，时空颠倒，恒星衰亡，众生罹难。
毁灭旧世界后，它们就会销声匿迹，此后天地再生，秩序重建，生命复苏，新世界诞生。
……
深夜时分，天上下起了瓢泼大雨。
密密麻麻的乌云像是亿万的恶鬼一样堆积在一起，凶恶的看着这阴暗的人间。
无数刺眼的雷霆电蛇在云层之间游窜，爆发出震耳欲聋的雷鸣声音，天地都瑟瑟发抖。
“天命，救我！”
李天命头痛欲裂，他在暴雨的冲刷之下，艰难的睁开了眼睛。
在他眼前，趴着一只拥有两对金色羽翼的鹏鸟。
这原本神骏的鹏鸟此时伤痕累累，身上血流如注，和暴雨汇聚在一起染红了大片的土地。
“金羽！”
李天命看到这一幕，心如同被割裂一样！
因为，这是他的伴生兽‘四翼金翅大鹏鸟’，是他并肩作战十六年的生死兄弟！
轰隆！
一声惊雷炸响，闪电划破天际，光芒闪耀的瞬间，一头紫色的三眼雄鹰从天而降！
那三眼雄鹰身上缠绕着密密麻麻的电蛇，它发出凶狠的嘶叫，锋利的爪子压住了‘金羽’。
然后，它张开鸟喙，将‘金羽’身上那金色羽毛一片片的拔下来。
每拔开一片羽毛，就是一片血窟窿！
金羽的惨叫声音，像是倒刺扎进了李天命的胸腔，让他连呼吸都刺痛！

“李天命，你竟然意图下药侵犯‘沐晴晴’，鉴于你这禽兽不如的行径，我作为炎黄学宫‘天府弟子’，必须惩戒你！”
那三眼雄鹰上正坐着一个少年，那少年双目之间如有雷池，在这电闪雷鸣之间，他驾驭三眼雄鹰，如同雷霆之子。
“念在你平日表现良好的份上，留你一条生路，判处你伴生兽‘四翼金翅大鹏鸟’死刑！”
少年沉声宣告。
他这是要将‘金羽’凌迟处死！
“霆哥，‘圣兽战魂’是你的了，李天命这个下作的人渣，根本不配得到这样的神物。”
少年身边依偎着一位绝色少女。
在这倾盆大雨的肆虐之中，她浑身都已经湿透，窝在少年怀里的身段十分曼妙。
她就是沐晴晴，李天命化成灰都认识她！
她口中的霆哥，就是坐在那三眼雄鹰身上的雷霆少年林潇霆！
李天命终于想起来了——
他们杀‘金羽’的目的，是要抢夺‘圣兽战魂’！
这个国度之中，谁都知道圣兽战魂是多么珍贵的东西，其价值连城，乃是传说之中的‘圣兽’死后遗留。
据说圣兽战魂的功效，可以造就出凌驾于众生的强者！
李天命得到的圣兽战魂，已经被‘金羽’炼化到了自身羽毛之中。
content_en:
Legend has it that whenever heaven falls and reincarnation comes to an end, ten 'ancient chaotic beasts' will be born in the endless realm.
They have huge bodies comparable to the realm of gods. Wherever they go, the sky breaks apart, time and space are reversed, stars decay, and all living beings suffer.
After destroying the old world, they will disappear. After that, the world will be regenerated, order will be rebuilt, life will be revived, and a new world will be born.
…
Late at night, it started pouring rain.
Dense dark clouds piled together like billions of evil spirits, looking fiercely at this dark world.
Countless dazzling thunder and lightning snakes swam between the clouds, erupting with deafening thunder sounds that made the world tremble.
"Destiny, save me!"
Li Tianming had a splitting headache. He opened his eyes with difficulty under the heavy rain.
In front of him, there lay a roc with two pairs of golden wings.
This originally divine roc was now covered in scars and blood was pouring from its body. Together with the heavy rain, it stained a large area of ​​land red.
"Golden Feather!"
When Li Tianming saw this scene, his heart felt like it was being torn apart!
Because this is his companion beast ‘Four-Winged Golden-Winged Dapeng’, his life-and-death brother who has fought side by side for sixteen years!
Boom!
There was a loud thunder, lightning pierced the sky, and the moment the light shone, a purple three-eyed eagle fell from the sky!
The three-eyed eagle was wrapped with dense electric snakes. It screamed fiercely, and its sharp claws pressed down on the 'golden feather'.
Then, it opened its beak and plucked out the golden feathers on the 'Golden Feather' body piece by piece.
Every time a feather is pulled out, there is a bloody hole!
Jin Yu's screams were like barbs piercing Li Tianming's chest, making his breathing sting!
"Li Tianming, you actually intend to drug 'Mu Qingqing' and violate her. In view of your behavior that is worse than a beast, as a 'Tianfu disciple' of Yanhuang Academy, I must punish you!"
There is a young man sitting on the three-eyed eagle. There is a pool of thunder between the young man's eyes. In the midst of the lightning and thunder, he controls the three-eyed eagle like a son of thunder.
"In consideration of your good behavior, I will leave you a way to survive and sentence your companion beast 'Four-Winged Golden-Winged Dapeng' to death!"
The young man declared in a deep voice.
He is going to execute ‘Jin Yu’ Ling Chi!
"Brother Ting, the 'Holy Beast War Soul' is yours. Li Tianming, a scumbag, doesn't deserve such a divine object at all."
Next to the boy was a stunning girl.
In the raging downpour, she was soaked all over, and her figure nestled in the boy's arms was very graceful.
She is Mu Qingqing, even Li Tianming knew her even after he turned into ashes!
The Brother Ting she talks about is Lin Xiaoting, the thunderous young man sitting on the three-eyed eagle!
Li Tianming finally remembered——
Their purpose of killing 'Golden Feather' was to snatch the 'Holy Beast War Soul'!
Everyone in this country knows how precious the Holy Beast War Soul is. It is extremely valuable and is the legacy of the legendary 'Holy Beast' after its death.
It is said that the power of the holy beast's war spirit can create a strong man who is superior to all living beings!
The holy beast battle soul that Li Tianming obtained has been refined into his own feathers by the 'Golden Feather'.
